reasons.text: About 11% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with a hot July (corn flowering), corn yields here tend to be about 21 bu/ac lower.
In years with little rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 6 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -37 bu/ac in 2012 to about +6 bu/ac in 2009.

twins_note.text: Counties like yours: 5. Their corn yield: 111–181 bu/ac (typical 149). Similar soil and weather doesn't guarantee the same result.
